headline: Hiểu Vy and Sunstone North Lab surge up ARC-2 standings

sections.text: Hiểu Vy gained 6.81 points to reach 44.03, moving from 61st to 36th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board. Sunstone North Lab gained 5.00 to reach 44.58, rising from 52nd to 35th.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
